tldr: 台股8月28日收漲356點至46331點，量能重返兆元、外資買超415億元，連三紅站回46000點。
AI需求帶動先進封裝循環，台積電CoWoS月產能拚向10萬片，日月光2026資本支出上調至約105億美元。
主管機關為壽險業2026接軌TIS新制緩衝，8家金控獲資本減壓，並預告明年8項保險新制。
美股方面，Fed主席華許在傑克森霍爾對通膨發表鷹派談話，9月升息機率升至約六成、拖累晶片股，標普500週五收黑但仍收紅一周。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲356點收46331點 量能重返兆元
items.title_en: TAIEX climbs 356 points to 46,331 as turnover tops NT$1 trillion
items.summary_zh: 台股8月28日開高走高，加權指數終場大漲356點、收在46331點，漲幅0.77%，成交量回升至1.023兆元、為8月18日以來再度破兆。台積電漲10元至2420元，聯發科勁揚3.1%至3985元，市場受輝達財報亮眼與蘋果新品期待激勵，帶動指數重返46000點大關作收，權值與科技股同步走強。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index closed Friday up 356 points, or 0.77%, at 46,331, with trading value back above NT$1 trillion (NT$1.023tn) for the first time since Aug 18. TSMC added NT$10 to NT$2,420 and MediaTek jumped 3.1% to NT$3,985, lifted by strong Nvidia earnings and Apple-launch expectations, pushing the index back above the 46,000 mark into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 外資延續買盤 單日買超415億元
items.title_en: Foreign investors extend buying streak, snap up NT$41.5bn
items.summary_zh: 外資8月28日單日買超台股415億元、單周累計買超1107億元，偏好聯電與金控股，期貨部位同步翻多。三大法人合計買超468億元，帶動大盤連三紅並重新站上46000點。量能放大與外資回流顯示市場風險偏好回升，法人資金明顯回補權值股與金融族群，短線人氣延續。
items.summary_en: Overseas funds bought a net NT$41.5 billion on Friday and NT$110.7 billion for the week, favouring UMC and financial-holding shares while turning net-long in futures. The three major institutional investors together bought a net NT$46.8 billion, underpinning the index's third straight advance and its push back above 46,000, signalling a clear rebound in risk appetite and rotation into heavyweight and financial names.

items.title_zh: 台積電加速CoWoS擴產 AI需求供不應求
items.title_en: TSMC accelerates CoWoS expansion as AI demand strains supply
items.summary_zh: AI晶片需求強勁，台積電加速擴充先進封裝產能，CoWoS月產能估自目前約4萬片，年底前拉升至10~10.5萬片，2026年先進封裝產業成長上看四至五成。台積電預計吃下輝達近九成CoWoS訂單，同時釋出更多外包訂單給封測夥伴，重塑台灣封裝與設備供應鏈，帶動相關概念股題材延燒、資本支出續增。
items.summary_en: TSMC is ramping advanced-packaging capacity as AI-chip demand outstrips CoWoS supply. Monthly CoWoS output is projected to rise from about 40,000 wafers now toward 100,000-105,000 by end-2026, with 2026 industry growth of 40-50% expected. TSMC is set to take close to 90% of Nvidia's CoWoS orders while releasing more work to outsourced test-and-assembly partners, reshaping Taiwan's packaging and equipment supply chain.

items.title_zh: 日月光上調2026資本支出至105億美元
items.title_en: ASE lifts 2026 capex to US$10.5bn on advanced-packaging boom
items.summary_zh: 封測龍頭日月光投控將2026年資本支出上調至約105億美元，其中約七成投入先進封裝(LEAP)。公司預期2026年LEAP營收將超越原訂35億美元目標，2027年目標更上修至至少75億美元。受惠台積電CoWoS外包與AI封測需求，先進封裝進入多年成長循環，外資看好營運續強並調高目標價，封測族群動能延續。
items.summary_en: Packaging leader ASE Technology raised its 2026 capital-expenditure guidance to about US$10.5 billion, with roughly 70% earmarked for leading-edge advanced packaging (LEAP). The group now expects 2026 LEAP revenue to top its original US$3.5 billion target and lifted 2027 guidance to at least US$7.5 billion, as CoWoS outsourcing from TSMC and AI test-and-assembly demand drive a multi-year up-cycle.

items.title_zh: 壽險2026接軌TIS 主管機關推資本緩衝措施
items.title_en: Regulators cushion insurers' 2026 shift to new TIS solvency regime
items.summary_zh: 配合2026年壽險業接軌新一代清償能力制度(TIS)，主管機關推出過渡措施：8家壽險型金控獲資本減壓，11家的資本適足率(CAR)可延後申報。金管會並預告「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」修正草案，透過分階段緩衝降低接軌衝擊，兼顧壽險與金控資本穩健，避免一次性提列造成資本壓力。
items.summary_en: As insurers adopt Taiwan's new-generation solvency regime (TIS) in 2026, regulators are easing the transition: eight insurance-heavy financial holding companies receive capital relief and 11 may defer their capital-adequacy (CAR) filings under transitional measures. The FSC has also pre-announced draft amendments to the consolidated capital-adequacy rules for financial holding companies, phasing in the change to safeguard sector stability.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布明年8項新制 壽險業迎大轉型
items.title_en: FSC flags eight new rules driving life-insurance overhaul
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布明年將上路的8項新制，壽險業迎接大轉型，內容涵蓋清償能力、商品結構與資訊揭露，配合IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度接軌。新制引導壽險業強化資本、回歸保障型商品並提升風險揭露透明度，被視為近年最大規模的保險監理變革，將牽動業者商品策略與資本規劃布局。
items.summary_en: The FSC has outlined eight new measures taking effect next year that will drive a major transformation of the life-insurance industry, spanning solvency, product structure and disclosure rules as the sector aligns with IFRS 17 and the new solvency framework. The changes push insurers toward stronger capital, protection-oriented products and clearer risk disclosure, marking one of the industry's biggest regulatory overhauls in years.

items.title_zh: 高資產家族境外配置近乎標配
items.title_en: Offshore allocation now standard for Taiwan's UHNW families
items.summary_zh: 中國信託與BCG發布的財富洞察報告顯示，台灣超高資產家族的境外資產配置日益普及：資產逾億元族群約69%已持有境外資產，進入十億元超高資產層級後比重升至約86%，境外配置幾近標配。反映跨境booking、信託與私人銀行結構需求升溫，隨高資產業務專區擴大，財管業者爭相布局傳承與海外資產規劃商機。
items.summary_en: A wealth study from CTBC and BCG shows how concentrated offshore allocation has become among Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth families: roughly 69% of those with over NT$100 million in assets already hold offshore assets, rising to about 86% once wealth exceeds the NT$1 billion tier. The findings underscore rising demand for cross-border booking, trusts and private-banking structures as Taiwan expands its high-asset platform.

items.title_zh: 高股息ETF買氣延續 00881殖利率逾9%居冠
items.title_en: Dividend-ETF appetite stays strong; 00881 tops yields at 9%
items.summary_zh: 台灣高股息與存股ETF買氣延續至8月下旬，全月共37檔台股ETF除息，其中00881以約9.04%殖利率居冠。定期定額標的持續由純高股息擴散至市值型與主題型ETF，如0050、00919、00878等。ETF仍是散戶「存股」與穩定領息配置核心，投資人關注配息、殖利率與最後買進日，資金持續分散布局多元題材。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's dividend-ETF appetite held firm into late August, with 37 equity ETFs going ex-dividend in the month; among them 00881 topped the yield table at about 9.04%. Regular-investment flows kept broadening beyond pure high-dividend names toward market-cap and theme ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878, keeping ETFs central to retail 'stock-saving' portfolios and steady-income strategies.

items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax brackets widen after 12.4% CPI trigger
items.summary_zh: 因累計消費者物價指數上漲12.42%、達到調整標準，台灣2026年遺產稅課稅級距上調，但免稅額與各項扣除額因未達調整門檻而維持不變。級距放寬使較大額遺產的實質稅負略減，對高資產家庭而言是年底前規劃財富傳承與贈與節奏時須納入考量的一環，宜及早試算配置。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 2026 estate-tax brackets have been raised because cumulative CPI rose 12.42%, crossing the adjustment threshold, while the basic exemption and deductions stay unchanged as they did not meet the trigger. The wider brackets modestly ease the effective burden on larger estates, a point for high-asset families to factor into succession and gifting plans as year-end approaches.

items.title_zh: 2026贈與稅免稅額244萬 父母合計488萬
items.title_en: Gift-tax exemption stays at NT$2.44m per parent for 2026
items.summary_zh: 2026年台灣贈與稅每人年免稅額維持244萬元，父母各有額度，一年合計可免稅贈與子女488萬元；10%稅率級距上限為2811萬元、15%級距上限為5621萬元。實務上，家庭常善用每年免稅額度分年移轉財產給下一代，一方面完成傳承，一方面壓縮未來遺產稅基，降低整體稅負。
items.summary_en: For 2026, Taiwan's annual gift-tax exemption remains NT$2.44 million per giver, so both parents together can gift up to NT$4.88 million tax-free each year, with the 10% rate applying up to NT$28.11 million and 15% up to NT$56.21 million. Families often use the yearly allowance systematically to transfer wealth to the next generation while containing future estate-tax exposure.

items.title_zh: 台灣7月通膨2.54% 續高於2%目標
items.title_en: Taiwan's July inflation holds at 2.54%, above the 2% target
items.summary_zh: 台灣7月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增2.54%，續高於央行2%目標，1至7月平均漲1.81%。通膨連月高於目標，使央行政策立場承壓，市場對利率是否須維持偏緊持續討論；同時，出口與AI相關需求帶動的成長動能仍強，物價與景氣的拉鋸成為下半年貨幣政策的觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer price index rose 2.54% year-on-year in July, staying above the central bank's 2% goal, while the January-July average gain was 1.81%. Persistently above-target inflation keeps pressure on the CBC's policy stance and feeds market debate over whether rates need to stay firm, even as growth momentum from exports and AI-related demand remains strong.

items.title_zh: 景氣對策信號亮紅燈 工業生產年增近23%
items.title_en: Business-cycle signal flashes 'red' as output surges
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月景氣對策信號綜合判斷分數41分、亮出代表熱絡的紅燈，6月工業生產指數年增約22.95%。動能主要由半導體與AI相關供應鏈帶動，支撐企業獲利與出口接單；惟政策面須留意景氣過熱風險，以及傳統產業與科技業之間動能落差擴大，避免榮枯不均影響整體結構穩定。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's business-cycle monitoring indicator flashed a red light with a composite score of 41 in June, signalling a booming economy, while June industrial production jumped about 22.95% from a year earlier. The strength is led by semiconductors and AI-related supply chains, underpinning corporate earnings and export orders even as policymakers watch for overheating and uneven momentum across traditional sectors.

items.title_zh: 美債市場等不到了 華許傑克森霍爾恐亮升息底牌
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Warsh's Jackson Hole debut seen forcing a rate-hike hand
items.summary_zh: 鉅亨網報導，美債殖利率近期急升、加上財政部長貝森特罕見出手干預債市，為Fed主席華許首度傑克森霍爾演說鋪陳，市場愈發認定政策利率必須調高。美國通膨已連續逾五年高於2%目標，多名官員憂心，若FOMC遲遲不升息，央行公信力恐受損，牽動全球債匯與股市風險偏好。
items.summary_en: Taiwan outlet Anue reports that a sharp recent rise in US Treasury yields, plus a rare intervention in the bond market by Treasury Secretary Bessent, set the stage for Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole address, with markets increasingly convinced the policy rate must rise. US inflation has run above the 2% target for over five years, and officials worry the Fed's credibility could suffer if the FOMC delays.

items.title_zh: 美股8月創新高在望 華爾街大多頭點名5大利多
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Wall Street bulls eye five catalysts for August highs
items.summary_zh: 聯合新聞網報導，華爾街多頭認為AI需求強韌、財報穩健、政策訊號可望明朗與資金輪動等五大利多，有望推動美股再創8月新高，儘管投資人仍在等待傑克森霍爾會議的政策指引。此一樂觀框架凸顯本月多數時間，AI題材動能持續蓋過通膨與高利率疑慮，支撐風險資產表現。
items.summary_en: United Daily News highlights bullish Wall Street views that five tailwinds — resilient AI demand, solid earnings, expected policy clarity and rotation flows among them — could power US indices to fresh August highs, even as investors await the Fed's Jackson Hole signals. The upbeat framing underscores how AI momentum has been offsetting inflation and rate concerns for much of the month.

items.title_zh: 美股週五收黑 但仍收紅一周（2026-08-28）
items.title_en: US stocks slip Friday but post a winning week (2026-08-28)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街週五回檔，晶片股吐回部分本週漲幅：標普500指數跌約0.25%至7711.76點，那斯達克指數跌0.52%至26402.42點，輝達、英特爾、Marvell與Rubrik走弱，後兩者財報優於預期仍下挫。三大指數全週仍收紅，主要受惠輝達週四強勁財報與展望帶動、單日大漲約9%的餘威支撐。
items.summary_en: Wall Street pulled back on Friday as chipmakers gave up some of the week's gains: the S&P 500 fell about 0.25% to 7,711.76 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.52% to 26,402.42, weighed by Nvidia, Intel, Marvell and Rubrik, even though the latter two beat estimates. All three major indexes still finished higher for the week, helped by Nvidia's roughly 9% Thursday surge on strong results and guidance.

items.title_zh: Fed主席華許：通膨趨勢未見改善（2026-08-28）
items.title_en: Fed's Warsh warns inflation trends haven't improved (2026-08-28)
items.summary_zh: 在傑克森霍爾央行年會上，Fed主席華許發表鷹派談話，指通膨仍過高，過去一年PCE年增3.7%，並未顯示基本趨勢已實質改善。路透形容這是他迄今最接近承認可能需要升息的一次表態，使市場對聯準會下一步的辯論升溫，牽動全球利率與風險資產定價。
items.summary_en: At the Jackson Hole symposium, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish message that inflation remains too high, saying PCE is running at 3.7% over the past year and did not signal that underlying trends have meaningfully improved. Reuters called it the closest he has come to acknowledging rate hikes may be needed, sharpening the debate over the Fed's next move.

items.summary_zh: 華許談話引發市場快速重定價：據CME Group，9月升息機率升至近59%、前一日約35%，Polymarket對2026年升息押注一度升至約69%。對政策敏感的2年期美債殖利率一度勁揚9個基點至4.32%，美元指數上漲約0.4%，反映市場預期迅速轉向鷹派，全球資金風向短線明顯調整。
items.summary_en: Warsh's remarks triggered a sharp repricing: futures put the chance of a September rate hike near 59%, up from about 35% a day earlier per CME Group, while Polymarket odds of a 2026 hike jumped toward 69%. The policy-sensitive two-year Treasury yield rose as much as 9 basis points to 4.32% and the dollar gained about 0.4%, reflecting a swift hawkish shift in market expectations.

items.title_zh: 油價站上88美元 俄烏風險成焦點（2026-08-28）
items.title_en: Oil holds above $88 as Russia-Ukraine risk stays in focus (2026-08-28)
items.summary_zh: 布蘭特原油週五守在每桶88美元上方（約88.22美元），前一交易日反彈後延續，西德州原油約82.82美元；俄烏戰事升溫使地緣風險溢價續存，市場焦點從中東轉向東歐。油價當日變動有限，但仍遠高於一年前水準，能源價格對通膨與各國央行政策的牽動效應持續受關注。
items.summary_en: Brent crude held above US$88 a barrel on Friday (around US$88.22) after rebounding in the prior session, while WTI traded near US$82.82, as escalation in the Russia-Ukraine war kept a geopolitical risk premium in the market and shifted attention from the Middle East toward Eastern Europe. Prices were little changed on the day but remain sharply higher than a year ago.
